name: kx-connector-conformance-fixture
description: Pinned REAL third-party MCP servers dialed by the connector-conformance gate (D167 Extension Acceptance Gate). Installed deterministically via `npm ci` (the cached setup step); the assertions then run fully OFFLINE over a stdio subprocess, so no network flakiness enters the gate. The filesystem server takes its configuration as ARGUMENTS and reads no environment at all; the gitlab server reads two variables and exits(1) without the first, which is what makes it the subject of the environment-map proof.
